# onesignal_app (Data Source)

An app of the Organization API key's organization, by its App ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onesignal_app" "example" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

output "web_push_configured" {
  value = data.onesignal_app.example.web_configured
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The App ID.

### Read-Only

- `apns_bundle_id` (String) The iOS app's bundle ID.
- `apns_configured` (Boolean) Whether OneSignal holds an APNs credential.
- `apns_env` (String) The APNs environment.
- `chrome_web_origin` (String) The web push origin.
- `fcm_configured` (Boolean) Whether OneSignal holds a Firebase credential.
- `name` (String) The app's name.
- `organization_id` (String) The app's organization.
- `safari_site_origin` (String) The Safari web push origin.
- `site_name` (String) The website's name.
- `web_configured` (Boolean) Whether web push is configured.
